verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog announces private sub-teams for groups such as skunkworks efforts or teams handling sensitive data. It documents a 'Private to team members' setting, where the sub-team is hidden from everyone except members directly invited to it. Initiatives led by private teams are also visible only to team members. Missing for 10: documentation of who can create or configure private sub-teams (e.g. whether a non-admin PM can), step-by-step setup docs beyond changelog snippets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
